verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: product badge, headline, body, CTA. But the Quillbrook logo is shrunk to an unreadable ~12px circle squeezed into the fine-print row with the NEW HARVEST pill, the body copy wraps tightly onto two lines, and the fine print is tiny. B is worse: the body copy is shrunk to illegible micro text while 'Whole bean or ground to order' is set larger than it, which inverts the hierarchy. B also reduces the logo to a stray speck near the top right, crops a brown circle fragment off the right edge, and pushes the CTA and NEW HARVEST pill against the top and bottom edges.
